[P1] Keep invoked-function errors opaque

The invoked function controls this error metadata, but this branch passes its `errorType` to `Class.forName` and its `errorData` to the configured SerDes. An untrusted callee can initialize arbitrary caller classes and potentially trigger custom/Jackson construction. Preserve the remote `ErrorObject` without reconstructing a cause, or require an explicit allowlist/typed decoder, with a regression for callee-selected classes.
